aria: Animated recap of the Celtics' 123 to 101 road win at Philadelphia: Paul George's 3-pointer with 9 minutes 34 seconds left that made it 100 to 82, quarter-by-quarter scoring, his 36 points on 14-of-22 shooting, the top scorers, how the Celtics won, and the next game at Toronto.
notes: Box score from the Celtics' 123–101 road win over the Philadelphia 76ers on Nov 10, 2026, from the Covers, with game details from NBC Sports Boston's live blog, CelticsBlog (SB Nation, via Yahoo Sports), Yahoo Sports, VAVEL and NBC Sports. All 123 Celtics points and all 101 76ers points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores add up to both totals (62–51 at the half, matching VAVEL and CelticsBlog). George's 36 points on 14 of 22, 6 of 11 from three, match the Covers box score, Yahoo Sports and NBC Sports. Records and conference ranks are from the site's standings (data/season.json) after Tuesday's games: Boston 9–2 and first in the East (Yahoo Sports also has Boston ahead of the 9–3 Sixers for the East's best record), Toronto 5–5.

Philadelphia tied it 76–76 with 3:50 left in the third (NBC Sports Boston; CelticsBlog says Dean Wade's 26-footer tied it). Boston closed the third on a 15–6 run and opened the fourth on a 9–0 run to lead 100–82 with 9:34 left (NBC Sports Boston), a 24–6 run in all. The sources disagree on Boston's biggest lead (29 in the Covers box score, 25 in a Yahoo Sports report), so the reel doesn't show one. George's 17 by halftime and 14 in just over seven fourth-quarter minutes are from NBC Sports. Boston plays at Toronto on Wednesday at 7:00 PM ET, the second night of a back-to-back (Yahoo Sports; the site's schedule). This was the first of four meetings; the next is Jan. 21 at TD Garden (CelticsBlog).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Paul George's 3-pointer with 9:34 left in the fourth quarter, which made it 100–82 after two Payton Pritchard threes (NBC Sports Boston; CelticsBlog). The recaps don't describe how he got the shot, so it is drawn as the template's plain pull-up. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Boston Celtics or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to George’s listed 6-foot-9 and 220 pounds (Land of Basketball), with arms scaled to his 6-foot-11¼ wingspan at the 2010 draft combine (NBADraft.net), in the Celtics' road kit. His No. 13 is from Newsweek and Land of Basketball. His look isn't on file yet, so he is drawn as a team-colour silhouette. It is an original silhouette with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
